method: Direct sequential reading of final current main, before comparison to author coverage inventory; custom source-derived observations, not yet protocol-normalized.

observations.statement: Diamond invariant averaging counts the effective action once; Poincare reducibility and Faltings Hom give A as a factor of J_H over L prime. Congruence index and genus/Belyi bounds feed Javanpeykar, Gaudron-Remond and Bost to the explicit height exponent19; no polarization bound on the complementary factor is assumed.

Thirty-seven rational contacts use normalized odd valuation parity, including negative coordinate valuations, to apply the prior height19 bound to two slopes and each abscissa. Raw nonzero contacts exclude branch values; no primality premise is used for this soundness step.

Completeness fixes denominator D0 and all coefficients before invoking the inherited fixed-system prime theorem. Duplicate slopes are removed then restored; successor admissibility, denominator-prime even depth, same-prime reduction orders and private pole witnesses are retained. No uniform growing-denominator estimate is claimed.

Reciprocal log follows by differentiating the explicit recurrence and normalized invariant differential. The full tail is controlled using factorial denominator valuations for every j, then formal-log isometry gives relative order e. Actual formal membership and split good large prime are prerequisites.

Global truncated-log nonvanishing follows from the explicit dyadic valuation on Q(sqrt2), unit D and coefficient valuations one: either the constant or the last term is uniquely least. This does not assume good reduction at two.

Inherited qualifications and final metric/Frobenius/twist conventions remain stated inputs. Scalar and four-witness anchor retain their original roles, while reciprocal nonvanishing justifies beta quotient divisions; Lucas zero-ordinate branches are expressly separate.

Three-mode coverage is a finite incidence check on unchanged contact blocks. Small z places a point or its T0 translate in the formal group; doubling kills T0 and gives the logarithm valuation. Half-indices are used only after actual integer-multiple identities, not by discarding torsion.

Joint-chart equivalence is proved by reversible polynomial identities, excluding true difference poles via a rational norm contradiction. It retains regular zero difference and zero ordinate branches; positive primary-f valuation excludes the latter only at consumed places.

Private conic chooses one split root and opposite-parity norm-tree valuations propagate leaf bounds. The conclusion uses valuation(T_i)>=2e_i, not the stronger unjustified 2e_i R. Zero summands use infinite valuations; no global integrality or squareclass assumption.
Conic completeness uses norm-Euclidean Z[sqrt2], a norm-minus-one unit, rational parametrization and weak approximation after fields are fixed; private occurrences remain independent.

Linear-unit pole soundness is a local parity contradiction with explicit W=0 branch. Completeness imports the earlier fixed-U simultaneous realization/rank theorem only after checking positivity, local squares and mutual-square squarefree conditions. Conic approximation makes g small; witness conversion divides only by proved nonzero r,W,b.

Four-witness anchor consumes specific Koenigsmann local trace facts, supplemented by explicit dyadic square calculations and sum-of-squares valuation. Homogenization by nonzero C establishes existential projection equality, not a rational witness selection.

Local Lucas residual uses previously obtained integral log quotients modulo p^40. Quadratic evaluation equals the integer polynomial modulo that power; it does not impose a global field equality and proxy removal requires exclusive incidence plus later height contradictions.
